hero_banner_slide.css: @keyframes heroSlide { 0% { transform: translateX(-100%); opacity: 0; } 100% { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } } .hero-banner { animation: heroSlide 0.8s ease-out 1; }

nav_hover.css: .top-nav a { color: #FFFFFF; text-decoration: underline; padding: 4px 10px; transition: background-color 0.15s linear; } .top-nav a:hover { background-color: #FF6600; color: #FFFFFF; }

feature_box_appear.css: @keyframes featureAppear { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .feature-box.in-view { animation: featureAppear 0.5s ease-out both; }

tree_expand.css: .tree-nav ul { max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; transition: max-height 0.3s ease; } .tree-nav li.open > ul { max-height: 500px; }

cta_pulse.css: .btn-cta { background-color: #FF6600; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #993D00; padding: 5px 12px; font-weight: bold; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .btn-cta:hover { background-color: #CC5200; }

home.layout: Three-column table layout: 180px left tree nav, ~60% center column with blue gradient-substitute hero banner and three feature bullet boxes, ~20% right sidebar with press release and customer logo strip.

products.layout: Two-column layout with left tree nav and main content area featuring a highlighted product callout box on top followed by a bordered product catalog table and a product comparison table with alternating light-blue rows.

solutions.layout: Two-column layout with left tree nav and main content showing a 2x3 table grid of industry vertical cards (Financial Services, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Government, Retail) each with a customer quote block and Learn More link.

partners.layout: Two-column layout with left tree nav and main area containing partner tier badge table (Gold/Silver/Authorized), partner directory search form, benefits comparison table, and a Become a Partner CTA box.

about.layout: Two-column layout with left tree nav and main content stacking mission statement box, company timeline table since 1997, executive team photo grid table, press releases list, and awards/certifications badge strip.
